MERIDIAN CONSTRUCTORS & CO. 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Gujarat · IN 
 
 No. CC/13/2010/008 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Flyover - Gujarat Pkg-8" (bridges 
 
 flyovers), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 
 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 
 17/11/2010 at a gross executed value of Rs. 17.08 Crore (Rupees 17.08 Crore
 Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in
 order and the workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming
 part of the contract. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Kavita Reddy. This 
 certificate is issued for record and for submission with future tenders wherever
 the contractor is required to establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Meridian Constructors & Co.
